scope: early base-LM continuation sanity; not assistant evaluation

interpretation.pipeline_signal: positive: checkpoint can generate and Polish token/phrase structure is emerging
interpretation.quality_signal: too early: outputs remain semantically incoherent and usually exhaust the token budget
interpretation.preset_observation: normal is less erratic than creative, but neither is useful at step 1000
interpretation.decision: treat 1k as successful mechanical validation only; do not call it a usable language model
